snippet.title: TRAILER | HELENA : Cloud District
snippet.description:
HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

Steam page :  https://store.steampowered.com/app/5190580/HELENA__Cloud_District/

We are a small indie team working on our 1rstproject and aiming at releasing a completed game at the end of October. Support us by wishlisting Helena : Cloud District ! 

#indiedev #indiegame #trailer #videogames  #megastructure #clouddistrict
